# Wajid Ali — Software Engineer & Product Builder

Wajid Ali builds custom SaaS, business applications, high-performance websites,
and automation workflows. Discuss project fit and current availability directly;
this site does not make an unconditional availability or delivery guarantee.

## Services and contact

- [Services](https://wajidali.dev/services): website design/redesign and performance,
  custom SaaS/business software, and AI automation/integration.
- Website packages start from PKR 45,000 / 95,000 / 175,000. Final scope and price
  require a written quote; software and automation are discovery-priced.
- [Project inquiry](https://wajidali.dev/services#inquiry): qualified business inquiries.
- Consultation scheduling uses an owner-configured event when available; otherwise
  request a free 20-minute consultation through the inquiry form.
- [Privacy](https://wajidali.dev/privacy): inquiry data handling.
- [About](https://wajidali.dev/about): engineering approach and owner-maintained career history.
- [Contact](https://wajidali.dev/#contact): separate business and recruiter paths.

## Selected work

- [Work](https://wajidali.dev/work): evidence-backed project case studies.

- [KnowledgeCity](https://wajidali.dev/work/knowledgecity): independent, unofficial

  not commissioned or endorsed by CloudCard.
- Additional projects and their evidence limits appear on the services page.

  not a verified commercial client deployment. No conversion/revenue/customer count
